---
title: "Ablation Study"
---

## What — Experiment Identity

- **Experiment**: Isolate the contribution of each SART component (Reweighting vs. Gradient Surgery) by removing one at a time

## Why — Experiment Purpose

- **Claim addressed**: Claim 2 — Reweighting and Surgery are super-additive (+26.7pp synergy bonus on robustness)

---

## Results — Table 3: Component Ablation

| Configuration | Accuracy | Robustness | Grad. Align. | SC Det. F1 |
|--------------|----------|------------|-------------|------------|
| SFT (Baseline) | 68.8% | 19.4% | -0.08 | — |
| + Reweighting Only | 75.2% | 40.1% | -0.06 | 0.85 |
| + Gradient Surgery Only | 73.5% | 40.5% | -0.14 | 0.82 |
| **SART (Full)** | **92.5%** | **87.9%** | **-0.03** | **0.64** |

---

## Analysis

<details>
<summary><strong>Super-Additive Synergy</strong></summary>

| Metric | Reweighting | Surgery | Sum | Full SART | Synergy |
|--------|------------|---------|-----|-----------|---------|
| Robustness gain | +20.7pp | +21.1pp | 41.8pp | **+68.5pp** | **+26.7pp** |
| Accuracy gain | +6.4pp | +4.7pp | 11.1pp | **+23.7pp** | **+12.6pp** |

The synergy arises because the two mechanisms operate on **complementary axes**:

- Reweighting adjusts *how much* each sample contributes to the loss
- Surgery adjusts *in which direction* each gradient update proceeds

When combined, reweighted gradients are more amenable to precise surgical correction, and surgery amplifies the effect of reweighting by eliminating residual shortcut directions.

</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>Gradient Alignment Improvement</strong></summary>

The full method achieves near-zero gradient misalignment (-0.03), a **2.7x improvement** over SFT (-0.08).

Removing either component causes catastrophic degradation:

- Without Reweighting: -19.0pp accuracy, -47.4pp robustness
- Without Surgery: -17.3pp accuracy, -47.7pp robustness

Both components are essential and contribute approximately equally.

</details>

<details>
<summary><strong>Claim Status</strong></summary>

- **Claim 2 status**: Confirmed — synergy bonus of +26.7pp (64% more than the sum of parts)
- Both components are independently beneficial but dramatically better together

</details>
